rendering_rules: Replace every {{slot}} with its value. Values are single-line plain text.
If a slot of kind 'line_optional' is empty, remove the whole line that contains it.
If a slot of kind 'inline_optional' is empty, replace it with an empty string and keep the line.
After rendering, no '{{' or '}}' may remain.
All text outside slots is fixed. The generator never changes it.

slots.name: languages
slots.rule: Names of profile.languages.working joined with ', ' and ' and ' (English names)

slots.name: deadline_terms
slots.rule: Union of keyword_packs[lang].deadline for all working languages, each term in double quotes, joined with ', '

slots.name: label_handoff
slots.rule: labels[overview].ignore_or_handoff; use the '_delegate' variant when profile.role.has_team is true

slots.name: followup_examples
slots.rule: labels[overview].followup_examples, each in double quotes, joined with ', '

slots.name: role_line
slots.description: Job title, department and organization in one phrase, e.g. 'Data and Business Analyst in the Outsourcing and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) department at [company], a financial institution'. Starts lowercase only if it starts with a common noun.

slots.name: responsibilities
slots.description: 4-8 responsibilities, separated by '; ', no final period.

slots.name: ongoing_topics
slots.description: Current topics from the profile, separated by ', '. If the profile has none, '[e.g. <2-3 role-typical examples>]'.

slots.name: tools
slots.description: Work tools from the profile. Empty if the role does not depend on specific tools and the profile names none.

slots.name: stakeholders
slots.description: Priority senders: named people first, then groups, then external parties. Missing names become placeholders such as '[manager]'.

slots.name: search_signals
slots.description: 3-6 role-specific search topics separated by '; ' (e.g. 'data, report and analysis requests; register updates').

slots.name: action_verbs
slots.description: Verb list of what counts as action for this role, e.g. 'reply, decide, approve, deliver, attend, or delegate'.

slots.name: waiting_parties
slots.description: Starts with a space, e.g. ' (vendor, business owner, IT)'. Empty if not typical.

slots.name: fyi_risk_examples
slots.description: 3-4 role-specific risks hidden in FYI mail, separated by ', '.

slots.name: sender_rule
slots.description: Who scores 5, e.g. 'manager or key stakeholder = 5'.

slots.name: urgency_signals
slots.description: Role-specific urgency signals separated by ', '. Always include 'sender waiting more than 3 days'.

slots.name: ownership_rule
slots.description: E.g. 'only the user can act = 5; easy to delegate = 1'. Use 'hand over' instead of 'delegate' when the user has no team.

slots.name: solution_guidance
slots.description: Starts with a space. Extra role-specific guidance, e.g. ' For data or report requests, name the likely data source, the analysis steps, and the open questions for the requester (scope, period, format, deadline).' Empty if not needed.

slots.name: draft_style
slots.description: Comma list of style adjectives from profile.style, e.g. 'concise, professional, decisive and friendly'.

slots.name: draft_extra
slots.description: Starts with a space and ends with ';'. E.g. ' when giving data, state source and as-of date;'. Empty if not needed.

slots.name: placeholder_example
slots.description: Short example in the overview language, e.g. 'rozpočet' or 'register value'.

slots.name: discretion_rule
slots.description: One sentence on confidential topics typical for the role, ending with ': summarize only what the user needs to act.' Replace 'the user' with the user name.

slots.name: org_rule
slots.rule: profile.org_context.mandatory_rule (set by the organization admin, validated). Empty if none.
